name: UISP
description: All-in-one docker image for Ubiquiti UISP (formerly UNMS). Supports x86_64 and ARM (Raspberry Pi).

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-uisp application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-uisp
  # The `big-bear-uisp` service definition
  big-bear-uisp:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-uisp
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: nico640/docker-unms:2.4.155.1@sha256:f7f3f7820cb3e86bfbe0691585410482b5079f9708b400c810fbdc4cc9fd6590
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for the container
    environment:
      - TZ=UTC
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local /DATA/AppData/big-bear-uisp/config directory to /config inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 80 of the container
      - "8080:80"
      # Mapping port 10443 of the host to port 443 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:443"
